user-registration-diagram.title: User Registration Diagram
user-registration-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant A as Express API
    participant R as Router / Middleware
    participant CO as Controller
    participant V as Validator
    participant OS as OTP Service
    participant ES as Email Service
    participant H as Argon2id
    participant Repo as Repository
    participant DB as PostgreSQL

    Note over C,DB: 1. Request Registration OTP
    C->>A: POST /register/otp
    A->>R: Route + Middleware
    R->>CO: Forward request
    CO->>V: Validate email + username
    V-->>CO: Valid data
    CO->>OS: sendRegistrationOtp(email, username)
    OS->>OS: Generate 6-digit OTP
    OS->>OS: SHA-256 hash OTP
    OS->>ES: Send OTP email
    ES-->>C: Verification email
    OS->>Repo: Create / replace OTP record
    Repo->>DB: INSERT / UPDATE OTP
    DB-->>Repo: Success
    Repo-->>OS: Success
    OS-->>CO: OTP sent
    CO-->>C: 200 otp_sent

    Note over C,DB: 2. Verify Registration OTP
    C->>A: POST /register/verify-otp
    A->>R: Route + Middleware
    R->>CO: Forward request
    CO->>V: Validate email + OTP
    V-->>CO: Valid data
    CO->>OS: verifyOtp(email, otp, registration)
    OS->>OS: SHA-256 hash submitted OTP
    OS->>Repo: Get OTP record
    Repo->>DB: SELECT OTP
    DB-->>Repo: OTP record
    Repo-->>OS: OTP record
    OS->>OS: Check expiry + code + verified state
    OS->>Repo: Mark OTP verified
    Repo->>DB: UPDATE verified = TRUE
    DB-->>Repo: Success
    Repo-->>OS: Success
    OS-->>CO: OTP verified
    CO-->>C: 200 otp_verified

    Note over C,DB: 3. Create Account
    C->>A: POST /register
    A->>R: Route + Middleware
    R->>CO: Forward request
    CO->>V: Validate email + password + username + OTP
    V-->>CO: Valid data
    CO->>OS: Check registration OTP verified
    OS->>Repo: Get OTP verification state
    Repo->>DB: SELECT verified
    DB-->>Repo: Verification state
    Repo-->>OS: verified = TRUE
    OS-->>CO: Authorized
    CO->>H: Hash password with Argon2id
    H-->>CO: Password hash
    CO->>Repo: Create user
    Repo->>DB: INSERT user
    DB-->>Repo: User created
    Repo-->>CO: Success
    CO->>Repo: Delete registration OTP
    Repo->>DB: DELETE OTP
    DB-->>Repo: Success
    Repo-->>CO: Success
    CO-->>C: 201 account_created

    Note over C,DB: Registration fails if OTP is missing, expired, incorrect, or unverified

user-login-diagram.title: User Login Diagram
user-login-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant API as Express API
  participant MW as Router/Middleware
  participant Ctrl as Controller
  participant Val as Validator
  participant Svc as OTP Service
  participant UserSvc as User Service
  participant Argon as Argon2id
  participant Email as Email Service
  participant Token as TokenSvc
  participant Repo as Repository
  participant DB as Database

  Note over Client,DB: 1. Request Login OTP
  Client ->> API: POST /login/otp
  API ->> MW: Request
  MW ->> Ctrl: Request
  Ctrl ->> Val: req.body
  Val -->> Ctrl: Validated email + password / throws ValidationError
  Ctrl ->> Svc: sendLoginOtp(email, password)
  Svc ->> Repo: Find user credentials by email
  Repo ->> DB: Query user
  DB -->> Repo: User row (id, username, hashed password)
  Repo -->> Svc: User credentials
  Svc ->> Argon: Verify(password, hash)
  Argon -->> Svc: Match result
  alt user not found or password mismatch
    Svc -->> Ctrl: throw AuthError
    Ctrl -->> MW: next(err)
    MW -->> Client: 401 Error response & log
  else password matches
    Svc ->> Svc: Generate 6-digit OTP
    Svc ->> Svc: SHA-256 hash OTP
    Svc ->> Email: Send OTP email
    Email ->> Email: Nodemailer → SMTP
    Email -->> Svc: Email sent
    Svc ->> Repo: Create/replace login OTP
    Repo ->> DB: Insert/Update OTP record
    DB -->> Repo: Success
    Repo -->> Svc: Success
    Svc -->> Ctrl: OTP sent
    Ctrl -->> MW: 200 otp_sent
    MW -->> Client: 200 OTP sent
  end

  Note over Client,DB: 2. Verify Login OTP
  Client ->> API: POST /login/verify-otp
  API ->> MW: Request
  MW ->> Ctrl: Request
  Ctrl ->> Val: req.body
  Val -->> Ctrl: Validated email + OTP / throws ValidationError
  Ctrl ->> Svc: verifyOtp(email, otp, login)
  Svc ->> Svc: SHA-256 hash submitted OTP
  Svc ->> Repo: Get login OTP record
  Repo ->> DB: Query OTP
  DB -->> Repo: OTP record
  Repo -->> Svc: OTP record
  Svc ->> Svc: Check expiry + code + verified state
  alt OTP invalid, expired, or already verified
    Svc -->> Ctrl: throw OtpError
    Ctrl -->> MW: next(err)
    MW -->> Client: 4xx Error response & log
  else OTP matches
    Svc ->> Repo: Mark OTP verified
    Repo ->> DB: UPDATE verified = TRUE
    DB -->> Repo: Success
    Repo -->> Svc: Success
    Svc -->> Ctrl: OTP verified
    Ctrl -->> MW: 200 otp_verified
    MW -->> Client: 200 OTP verified
  end

  Note over Client,DB: 3. Complete Login
  Client ->> API: POST /login
  API ->> MW: Request
  MW ->> Ctrl: Request
  Ctrl ->> Val: req.body
  Val -->> Ctrl: Validated email + password / throws ValidationError
  Ctrl ->> UserSvc: loginUser(email, password)
  UserSvc ->> Repo: Check login OTP verification
  Repo ->> DB: Query OTP verification state
  DB -->> Repo: verified = TRUE
  Repo -->> UserSvc: OTP verified
  UserSvc ->> Repo: Find user credentials by email
  Repo ->> DB: Query user
  DB -->> Repo: User row (id, hashed password)
  Repo -->> UserSvc: User credentials
  UserSvc ->> Argon: Verify(password, hash)
  Argon -->> UserSvc: Match result
  alt OTP not verified or password mismatch
    UserSvc -->> Ctrl: throw AuthError / OtpError
    Ctrl -->> MW: next(err)
    MW -->> Client: 4xx Error response & log
  else OTP verified and password matches
    UserSvc ->> Token: Generate session token
    Token ->> Repo: Store hashed token
    Repo ->> DB: Insert session
    DB -->> Repo: Session created
    Repo -->> Token: Success
    Token -->> UserSvc: Raw session token
    UserSvc ->> Repo: Delete login OTP
    Repo ->> DB: DELETE OTP record
    DB -->> Repo: Success
    Repo -->> UserSvc: Success
    UserSvc -->> Ctrl: token
    Ctrl -->> MW: Set-Cookie + 200 Success
    MW -->> Client: 200 Success
  end

default-diagram.title: Default Placeholder Diagram
default-diagram.definition:
sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant API
  participant DB
  Client->>API: request
  API->>DB: query
  DB-->>API: result
  API-->>Client: response
